    BindGroups []BindGroupBind
    Passes []PassBegin
    Draws []Draw
    DrawsIndexed []DrawIndexed
    Submits []Submit
}

type VertexBufferBind struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    Slot uint32
    Label string
    Offset uint64
    Size uint64
}
